title: Quality gate result
description: Every quality gate returns this object. Never free text. Never string-match a report to decide a gate.

passed.description: Derived from the gate rule, never asserted by prose.

blocking.description: Blocking findings. A blocking gate passes only when this is empty.

artefact.description: Project-relative path of the responsible file.

coverage.description: Required by the traceability gate. Percent, four-direction closure.

score.description: Required by the session_score gate. Threshold 28.

release_assessment.description: Required by the reporting gate. Never derived from pass percentage alone. Where the release decision is business-owned, this is an evidence-based QA recommendation, not an assumption of release authority.

residual_risk.description: What remains untested or unproven after this run. An empty residual risk on a real project is almost always a reporting failure, not a clean bill of health.

metrics.description: Free-form numeric metrics the gate asserted on.

evidence.description: What was inspected to reach this verdict. Paths, counts, commands run.
